== Palace Raider counts ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-retro-charity-event-prem-to-v3-top-8-casey-anis-ls-watch-your-step/ primary Players Committee deck article], dated 8 August 2025, lists four Palace Raiders and one Palace Raider (V). The article previously combined these as five virtual cards; the two rows now follow the primary source and retain the 60-card total. The existing public GEMP import independently repeats the four/one split, but it was not used as the sole authority.

The event's Modern Premiere–Virtual Set 3 card pool does not by itself establish its historical text cutoff. This count correction preserves the virtual row's existing source-version association through the Palace Raider (V) redirect; it does not select a different errata version from the event date or deck title.
